html:
G'oya

Natijada doim 7 ta qator bo'lishi kerak, tushum bo'lmagan kunlar ham. Shuning uchun so'rov sales dan emas, hafta kunlari ro'yxatidan boshlanadi. Uni VALUES bilan yozamiz: kun raqami va nomi. Keyin tushumlarni LEFT JOIN bilan ulaymiz va har kun uchun summani olamiz.

Yechim

Ikkala bazada ham hafta kuni raqami 0 dan 6 gacha, 0 yakshanba. PostgreSQL'da uni EXTRACT(DOW FROM ...), SQLite'da strftime('%w', ...) beradi.

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH days(dow, day_name) AS (
  VALUES (1, 'Dushanba'), (2, 'Seshanba'), (3, 'Chorshanba'), (4, 'Payshanba'),
         (5, 'Juma'), (6, 'Shanba'), (0, 'Yakshanba')
)
SELECT d.day_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) AS total
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN sales s ON EXTRACT(DOW FROM s.sale_date) = d.dow
GROUP BY d.dow, d.day_name
ORDER BY (d.dow + 6) % 7
Faqat SQLiteWITH days(dow, day_name) AS (
  VALUES (1, 'Dushanba'), (2, 'Seshanba'), (3, 'Chorshanba'), (4, 'Payshanba'),
         (5, 'Juma'), (6, 'Shanba'), (0, 'Yakshanba')
)
SELECT d.day_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) AS total
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN sales s ON CAST(strftime('%w', s.sale_date) AS INTEGER) = d.dow
GROUP BY d.dow, d.day_name
ORDER BY (d.dow + 6) % 7

(dow + 6) % 7 dushanbani 0 ga, yakshanbani 6 ga aylantiradi, shuning uchun saralashda yakshanba oxiriga o'tadi. Tushumi yo'q kunda SUM NULL beradi, COALESCE uni 0 qiladi.

Tuzoqlar

ORDER BY d.dow yozilsa, yakshanba ro'yxat boshiga chiqadi. Yakshanbani 7 deb yozish ham yordam bermaydi: DOW hech qachon 7 qaytarmaydi va yakshanbaning tushumi yo'qoladi.

SQLite'dagi strftime son emas, matn qaytaradi: '1'. SQLite'da matn '1' va son 1 teng emas, shuning uchun CAST siz JOIN hech narsani ulamaydi va hamma kun 0 bo'lib chiqadi. Xato chiqmagani uchun buni sezish qiyin:

Noto'g'riWITH days(dow, day_name) AS (
  VALUES (1, 'Dushanba'), (2, 'Seshanba'), (3, 'Chorshanba'), (4, 'Payshanba'),
         (5, 'Juma'), (6, 'Shanba'), (0, 'Yakshanba')
)
SELECT d.day_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) AS total
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN sales s ON strftime('%w', s.sale_date) = d.dow
GROUP BY d.dow, d.day_name
ORDER BY (d.dow + 6) % 7

Kalendarsiz, sales ni CASE bilan guruhlasangiz, namunadagi chorshanba va payshanba natijada umuman bo'lmaydi.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM ...) ham bor: u dushanbani 1, yakshanbani 7 deb beradi va saralash uchun hiyla kerak bo'lmaydi. Bu yerda avval tushumlar kunlar bo'yicha guruhlanadi, keyin kalendar bilan ulanadi:

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH days(n, day_name) AS (
  VALUES (1, 'Dushanba'), (2, 'Seshanba'), (3, 'Chorshanba'), (4, 'Payshanba'),
         (5, 'Juma'), (6, 'Shanba'), (7, 'Yakshanba')
),
t AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM sale_date)::int AS n, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT d.day_name, COALESCE(t.total, 0) AS total
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN t ON t.n = d.n
ORDER BY d.n
